changes: Added `/rules`: posts the TheySix Discord rules as a Components V2 message (two accent-colored containers with dividers and link buttons for the ToS, guidelines, EULA, usage guidelines, and wiki legal pages), gated behind Manage Messages.
The rules content lives in one place (`rulesComponentPayload` in src/commands.js) with a `RULES_LAST_UPDATED` constant, so updating the rules text or date is a one-line change.

Removed the entire Question of the Day (QOTD) system: the scheduler, question bank CSV, `/settings qotd_channel` and `/settings qotd_role` options, QOTD SQLite tables and state helpers, and the reset script.
